notablePrerequisites: Ramos has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ramos to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Lux Artillery triggers, causing Ramos to gain sunburst and enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
